svg.title: Recovery tree
svg.desc: A behavior tree drawn top to bottom. At the top, tag 1, a blue box: Selector (memory on), named place_cell. Lines lead to its three children, left to right: tag 2, a blue box, EternalGuard named tester_1_ok; a gray box, skill place_on_tester_2; tag 4, a blue box, Running named hold_cell. Under the guard is tag 3, a blue box, Retry, 3 failures, named retry_3, and under it a gray box, skill place_on_tester_1. A note beside the tree says children are tried left to right.

path.aria-label: children are tried left to right
